# FLX-2122: the receipt and the plan of a run directory disagree

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

A run directory holds two records of what the run was: `plan.json`, whose planDigest pins the simulation it names and the emits it declares, and `receipt.json`, which `apply` wrote from the same plan. `fluxsim verify` and `fluxsim ship` read the simulation id and the emit ids back from the receipt, and an id becomes part of a file name (the golden record, each emit stream), so a receipt that names another simulation, or another set of emits, than the plan beside it was edited or assembled from another run. The refusal names the field that differs: the simulation id, or the emit ids the receipt lacks or adds. Run `fluxsim plan` and `fluxsim apply` again rather than editing a receipt.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2122
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
